name: Isometric City
desc: An axonometric city that builds itself block-by-block over bars, windows kindling in the loud sections while tiny headlights stream the streets, in soft pastel, cyan blueprint, noir chiaroscuro, or neon-night.

style.doc: render philosophy: soft axonometric pastel / cyan drafting blueprint (edges only) / noir chiaroscuro / neon night

act.doc: dramaturgy: build-once-and-stay / buildings rise and fall in waves / same build with heavy window life
